sections.text: مقدمة

This Document details major maintenance procedure P1 to be performed 
after 65,000 operations hours as indicated by H65,000 in the title block.

This Document details the programs for removal or insertion of the rotor, and stator visual inspections 
of the two ring and winding.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohmed Aly Aly Hassan, tested by eng. Al 
Shahat Ahmed Mousa, revised by EDEPC. quality control eng. Tawfik El abasery, 
and approved by AL Shabab power plant general director eng. Hamdy Melegy and 
certified by eng. Aly Mostafa AlLathy EDEPC. Quality control and Inspection Head 
Sector.
احتياطات السلامة

Work order must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area.

sections.text: الأعمال المطلوب تنفيذها
إزالة المثير
Removal the Exciter housing , including the collector brush rigging
Disconnect all oil lines, protecting the openings against entrance of dirt

Disconnect all electrical connections, pushing the cable ends below the floor 
 line if possible.
Remove all bolts and dowels holding the exciter base to the foundation
Check to see that all parts are free and that no Interference excite.

sections.text: Disassembly of Rotor
Remove brush holder rigging and complete direct connected exciter
Remove the coward (side the turbine) .
Remove the outside air shield rings and outside shields
Remove the inside air shield rings and inside air shields
Remove the pedestal cop. Oil deflectors and bearing lining.
Place a jacking device or support under the coupling end of the Rotor.

Program for Removal OR 
Insertion of the Rotor
Caution:

Don't suspend or set down the rotor in the vicinity of the 
 bearing surface (damage to the rotor).

Place Protective material (thick cardboard press pan or 
 sealing material).

Put the strips of wood between the two wire ropes (no slipping 
 the wire and adjusting the middle when loaded angle between loops equal 45
 o C).

sections.text:
Insertion of sliding plate. You 
 see the fig .1- Item 1 , fix the sliding plate on the rotor fan hubs in 
 وضع الساعة 12، اسحب الرافعة من خلال الشريط الثابت (البند 2، الشكل 1) 
 ) باستخدام الأسلاك النحاسية.

Insert the sliding plate on the 
 tensed sling between the supports ( item 4, fig. 1 ) in the upper position 
 when fitted, remove the sling ( item 2, fig 1) and the adjusting screws (item 
 3 , fig. 1) press at both ends the sliding plate with the supports ( item 4 , 
 fig .1 ) to the erection device, turn the rotor until the sliding plate is 
 reaching the 6 O clock position loosen, the screws ( item 5, fig . 1 ) until 
 the sliding plate lays in the stator bar. Remove supports (item 4, fig.1) at 
 driving side.

Fix the inter- mediate piece ( 
 item 7, fig. 2 ) for the sliding pad on the fan hubs at driving end in the
 12 O'clock position .

Turn the rotor until the inter- 
 mediate piece is reaching the position of the sliding plate : by the same, the 
 sliding plate erection device has turned again in the 12 O clock position and 
 can now be removed

Dismantle bearing brackets and 
 upper bearing parts.

Mount the lifting jack (item 8, 
 fig 2) at the B نهاية.

Lift the rotor as high as 
 possible using the crane at A end and the lifting jack at B end, 
 make sure that the rotor does not touch the stator windings and iron core.

Pull tow lengths of string 
 through the stator bar and use them to pull the sliding pad (item 9, fig. 2) 
 from the B end to the A end ( to keep connect the air pipe 
 line to the B end ), the distance between the pad and the end of the 
 stator iron core should be at 150 mm.

Put the second sliding pad (item 
 10, fig 2) unclear the fan hub with the inter- mediate piece ( to keep 
 connect the air pipe line to the A end )

Lower the rotor at both ends 
 until the A end lies on the pad ( item 9, fig 2) (in this position the rotor 
 is 1.5 mm above the centre line)

وبمساعدة الرافعة، 
 قم بتفكيك غلاف المحمل السفلي وحلقات المحمل عند كلا الطرفين.

Assemble bearing pedestal, 
 bracket and two part ring ( item 11) with threaded bolts ( item 12 ) and 
 nuts ( item 13) to the rotor shaft at the B end { all items Nos. refer 
 to ( fig.2 section c-c ) }

Change on B end of the 
 rotor from the lifting ,jack to the crane sling . then check with a spirit 
 level that the rotor remains at horizontal position

Open 
 the compressed air valve and take out the rotor with slight lateral 
 movements, advacing the crane accordingly

sections.text: انتباه

Watch the second sliding pad ( item 10, fig 2): as soon as 
 this pad is full contact with the stator core , the connection to the air 
 supply must be changed over .

Continue the withdraw of the rotor until its center of gravity 
 has approx. reached the midpoint of the bearing bedestal 
 support the gravity center line is approx 250 mm besides of the rotor 
 midpoint, i.e. the slot wedges centering screws .

Lower the rotor on the wooden support ( item 14, fig 3 ) and 
 set down the sling on the bearing pedestal support.
Dismantle lifting jack at the B end with the crane.

Lift the rotor with the sling and carefully pull it right out 
 of the stator bore.
